title: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
vacancyDetails: Education loan and student support application service under Bihar's Yuva Upmission.
qualification: Bihar students meeting the current Student Credit Card scheme conditions.
applicationFee: As per official portal and bank process.
selectionProcess: Online registration -> Counselling or verification -> Bank and department processing
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, Bihar residence, admission proof, academic documents, bank and co-applicant details.
howToApply: Open the official Yuva Upmission portal and select Bihar Student Credit Card application.
shortDescription: Bihar Student Credit Card education finance and student support services.
content:
The Bihar Student Credit Card portal provides education finance application and status services for eligible Bihar students.

Check the current course, institution, document and repayment conditions on the official portal before applying.
